purpose gap: Tested: smb.conf domain-member settings (security=domain, netbios name, realm, wins server, workgroup, separator); the join (net rpc testjoin on the node, machine account PUPPET8NODE$ on the DC); domain user and groups resolving through nsswitch/winbind (id of the join user, mismatch p8nouser); pam_winbind require_membership_of P8TEST+p8testgroup and /etc/pam.d/openvpn byte-identical; real PAM logins through the login service openvpn_server's plugin uses (member with right password accepted, wrong password refused, a non-member refused while wbinfo -a shows the DC accepts its password, isolating the membership rule).
